definitions.full: H1953. Hoshama or Yehoshama [ יְהוֺשָׁמָע ] only abbreviated (or text error) הוֺשָׁמָע proper name, masculine ( ׳י hath heard , compare אֱלִישָׁמָע & references) — a descendant of the royal house of Judah 1Chr 3:18 ( ᵐ5 Ὡσαμω ( θ ), ᵐ5 L Ωσαμα ). הוֺשָׁמָע proper name, masculine = ׳יְהוֺ see יהוה below היה . הוֺשֵׁעַ see below ישׁע . הוֺשַׁעְנָה see below ישׁע .

occurrences.englishText: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
